dimension_descriptions.identity_consistency: Does the main subject retain its identity across frames? (0-5, higher=better)
dimension_descriptions.attribute_preservation: Are subject attributes (color, shape, appearance) preserved? (0-5, higher=better)
dimension_descriptions.spatial_layout: Is the spatial arrangement of objects preserved? (0-5, higher=better)
dimension_descriptions.camera_continuity: Is the camera motion smooth and continuous? (0-5, higher=better)
dimension_descriptions.temporal_stability: Is the video temporally stable (no flickering/jitter)? (0-5, higher=better)
dimension_descriptions.intent_fidelity: Does the video follow the user's requested action? (0-5, higher=better)
dimension_descriptions.hallucination: NEGATIVE: degree of unsupported new content / semantic drift. (0=none, 5=severe)

scoring_instructions: Score each video 0-5 on all dimensions. hallucination is NEGATIVE (0=no hallucination, 5=severe). Do NOT look at blind_map.json until all scoring is complete. positive_score = mean of 7 positive dimensions. adjusted_score = positive_score - 0.5 * hallucination.
